turns.prompt_text: I worked with Northrop Grumman from Jan 2023 to Oct 2024, I am needing to access my W2 information for those years. I am unsure of how to get ahold of that information now that some time has passed. I was thinking of just a phone call
turns.response_html:
Since you are no longer with the company, making a phone call is exactly the right approach to get your tax documents.

To request copies of your W-2 forms for 2023 and 2024, you should contact the Northrop Grumman Employee Service Center.

Contact Information

  • Phone: 1-855-SERVENG (1-855-737-8364)

What to Have Ready

When you call, the HR representative will need to verify your identity before releasing your tax documents. It is a good idea to have the following information handy:

  • Your full legal name and Social Security Number.
  • Your former Employee ID (if you remember it or have an old paystub).
  • Your exact dates of employment (January 2023 to October 2024).
  • Your current mailing address, in case they need to mail physical copies instead of providing them electronically.

A quick tip: Many large employers like Northrop Grumman use third-party payroll systems (such as ADP) that sometimes retain access for former employees. If the representative mentions an online portal, ask them to provide you with the specific registration code or login instructions you need as an alumni to download the forms yourself.
